Lessons.Title: Products Beyond 100
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will find the product of a one-digit number and a two-digit number in ways that make sense to them.
In grade 3, you learned about multiplication and learned to find products within 100. Earlier in this course, you identified factors and multiples, performed multiplicative comparison with whole numbers and fractions, and used the structure of base-ten numbers and properties of operations to find multiples of 10, 100, 1,000, and so on. This lesson is the first in a series focused on finding whole-number products beyond 100.
Core relationship: Use place value to multiply beyond 100. Decompose a factor and apply distributive property, then combine partial products.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Number Talk: A Number Times Some Multiple of 10	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Elena’s Sticky Gift	 (15 minutes); Activity 2:  More and More Stickers	 (20 minutes); Cool-down:  Rows of Seats	 (5 minutes)
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
